verses.text: Ay jun k'uhal, ix xit'ek' winhaj Sansón t'a Gaza. Hata' ix yil jun ix ajmul ix winh, ix och winh t'a yol spat ix, ix waykan winh yet' ix t'a jun ak'wal chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' aj Gaza chi' to hata' ayek' winh, ix yoyan sb'a heb' t'a spatiktak pat chi', ix stanhwan spuerta'il chonhab' heb' t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Numan yaj heb', ix smaklan heb' yek' ak'wal chi'. Ix sna'an heb' to ha t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u ol smilcham winh heb'.

Palta haxo winhaj Sansón chi', ix stanhwej winh yoch chimilak'wal, ix k'e wa'an winh. Ix b'at winh t'a spuerta'il chonhab' chi', ix schokanelta jun niwan puerta chi' winh yet' smarcoal. Ix sjolom jenhjab'an winh, ix b'at yak'ankan winh t'a jolom witz t'a yichanh Hebrón.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ochpax spensar winh t'a jun ix skuchan Dalila kajan t'a jun ch'olan skuch Sorec.

Yuj chi', ix b'at lolon heb' winh yajalil heb' filisteo yet' ix Dalila chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix icha tik: --Tza montej wal winhaj Sansón chi', tza k'anb'an t'a winh b'ajtil skot jantak yip winh chi', tas wal skutej kak'an ganar winh ko tzek'ani, yik wach' maxtzak yal-laj skolan sb'a winh. Junjun onh ol kak' mil 100 siclo k'e'en plata t'ayach a tojolok, xchi heb' winh t'a ix.
Ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach, to tzal t'ayin b'ajtil skot jantak ip tik, ¿ay am wal tas tz'aj a tzek'ji yik maxtzak yal-laj a kolan a b'a? xchi ix t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix icha tik: --Tato tzin tzek'chaj t'a ukeok ch'anh ch'anh manto junelok sk'anchaji, tz'el wip tik, icha yip junok komon anima tzin ajkani, xchi winh t'a ix.
Yuj chi', a heb' yajalil heb' filisteo chi' ix ik'anb'at uke' ch'anh ch'anh chi' t'a ix Dalila chi', ix stzek'an winhaj Sansón chi' ix.

Ay juntzanh heb' winh toxo ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yol spat ix chi', yuj chi' te cha'anh ix el yaw ix: --Sansón, sjawi heb' winh filisteo ach smilchamok, xchi ix. T'a wal jun rato chi', ix st'inhchitanb'at juntzanh ch'anh ch'anh chi' winh. Icha sk'unal st'inhchaj junok anh ch'al tz'a'eltak, icha chi' ix yutej ch'anh winh. Haxo heb' filisteo chi' maj nachajel-laj yuj heb' b'ajtil skot yip winh chi'.
Ix yalanxi ix t'a winh: --Te chuk ach, ix a musej wal in sat. Ix esej t'ayin. Ha tikne'ik tzin tewi t'ayach to tzal t'ayin tas wal tz'aj a tzek'chaji, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Tato tzatz tzin utej a tzek'an yet' ch'anh lasu manta b'aj sk'anchaji, tz'el wip, icha yip junok komon anima tzin ajkani, xchi winh t'a ix.

Yuj chi', ix say juntzanh ch'anh lasu chi' ix, ix stzek'an winh ix t'a ch'anh. Ix helxi yaw ix: --Sansón, sjawi heb' winh filisteo ach smilchamok, xchi ix. Hanheja' t'a junelxo chi' ayxo heb' winh ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yol scuarto ix. Icha wal tz'aj st'inhchaj anh ch'al, icha chi' ix yutej ch'anh lasu chi' winh.

Ix yalanxi ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ichanhej tik in ixtani. Tzesejnhej t'ayin. Al wal t'ayin tas wal tz'aj ach ko tzek'ani, xchi ix. Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix: --Tato uke' tzutej a pach'uch'an xil in jolom jukan tik yet' anh ch'al, tzatz tzutejkanoch t'a te' jal-lab', tato icha chi', tz'elkan wip, icha wal yip junok komon anima tzin ajkani, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix b'oji way winh yuj ix. Ayik toxo ix way winh chi', ix sjalankanoch xil sjolom winh chi' ix yet' anh ch'al t'a te' jal-lab' chi'.
Ix stzatzb'itanem te' jal-lab' chi' ix, ix awaj ix: --Sansón, sjawi heb' winh filisteo ach smilchamok, xchi ix. Ix k'e juknaj winh, ix stok'ank'eta te jal-lab' chi' winh yet' anh ch'al chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ha ach tik, te esalwum ach. ¿Tas yuj tzala' to tzin a xajanej? Yoxelalxo in ixtan tik. Manh jab'ok tzal t'ayin b'ajtil skot jantak ip tik, xchi ix.
Junjun k'u aynhejoch ijan ix sk'anb'an t'a winh b'ajtil skot yip winh chi', yuj chi' ix tzaktzajk'e winh yet' ix.

Yuj chi' ix yalelta winh, b'ajtil skot yip winh chi', ix yalan winh: --Manto junelok sjoxjiel xil in jolom yiktax in alji, yujto ayik manto in alji chi', ix in sik'jikanel yuj Dios yik tzin och nazareo'al, syalelk'ochi to yiktaxon Dios waji. Yuj chi' tato ay mach sjoxanel xil in jolom tik, tz'elkan wip chi', icha junok komon anima tzin ajkani, xchi winh.

Ix nachajel yuj ix to a tikne'ik yel syal winh. Ix yalanb'at ix t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' filisteo chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, kotanhek t'a wal junelxo tik, toxo ix yalelta winh tas yuj te ay yip winh chi', xchi ix. Yuj chi' ix k'och heb' winh yil ix, yet'nak k'e'en tumin heb' winh.

Ix yak'an way winhaj Sansón chi' ix t'a sat xub', ix yawtan jun winh joxwajum ix. Haxo jun winh chi' ix joxanel uke' makan xil sjolom winh pach'uch'ab'il chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yel yip winh yuj ix, majxo yal skolan sb'a winh.

Ix awaj ix icha tik: --Sansón, sjawi heb' winh filisteo ach smilchamok, xchi ix. Ix el swayanh winh, am sna'an winh to olto yal skolan sb'a winh ichataxon t'a juntak el. Manh yojtakok winh tato toxo ix aktajkan winh yuj Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix ja heb' winh filisteo, ix stzek'an winh heb' winh, ix yik'ank'eta yol sat winh heb' winh, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' winh t'a chonhab' Gaza. Hata' ix yak'och k'e'en cadena nab'a bronce heb' winh t'a winh. Ix yak'anoch winh heb' winh t'a preso. Ix yak'anoch winh heb' winh munlajel t'a k'e'en jaxum trigo t'a yol preso chi'.
Palta haxo xil sjolom winh, ix syamxioch sk'ib'i.

Ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yajalil heb' filisteo t'a tzalajk'olal, yujto ix yamchaj winhaj Sansón yuj heb', ix yak'an silab' heb' t'a skomon diosal skuch Dagón, ix och ijan heb' sb'itan icha tik: Ha ko diosal tik ix ak'anoch winhaj Sansón t'a yol ko k'ab'. Haton jun winh kajk'o'ol, xchi heb'.

Hanheja' pax heb' anima, ayik ix yilanoch winhaj Sansón chi' heb', ix sb'itan sdiosal heb' icha tik: Ha ko diosal ix ak'anoch jun winh kajk'ol t'a yol ko k'ab', a winh nhusannaktz'a kawb'en. Tzijtum heb' ketchonhab' smak'nakcham winh, xchi heb'.

Ix te tzalaj heb' anima chi', ix sk'anankot winhaj Sansón chi' heb' yik smatz'an winh heb'. Ix yik'anelta winh heb' t'a yol preso, ix yak'anoch winh heb' t'a skal snanhal yoyal stemplo heb', yik syixtan winh heb'.
Ix yalan winh t'a jun winh kelem unin et'jinak: --Ik'inb'at t'a yoyal snanhal yol templo tik, t'a juntzanh yipumal yaji yik tzin och ijan jab'ok t'ay, xchi winh.

Masanil heb' yajalil chonhab', molanek' heb' t'a yol templo chi', te b'ut'an yuj anima, heb' winh winak yet' heb' ix ix. Ay am oxe' milok anima ayk'e t'a schab'il piso, wan smatz'an heb' tas tz'utaj winhaj Sansón chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a Jehová: Ach in Dios Wajalil, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzin a nakot t'a junelxo tik, tzak'an wip yik tzin pakan in b'a t'a heb' winh filisteo tik, yujto ix yik'k'eta yol in sat heb' winh, xchi winh.
Ix och wetz'wetz' winh t'a chab' niwak yoyal templo chi' t'a snanhal yo'ol, haton juntzanh kuchjinak yalil jun templo chi'.

Ix el yaw winh ix yalan winh: Junnhejokab' tz'aj in cham yet' heb' winh filisteo tik, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an yip winh yekan lanhchaj chab' niwak yoyal templo chi'. Ix kot lanhnaj templo chi' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' yajalil chonhab' chi' yet' t'a yib'anh masanil anima ayek' ta'. Ek'alto sb'isul anima ix cham yuj winh ayik ix cham winh chi' t'a yichanh heb' ix smak'cham winh ayik pitzanto.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' yuk'tak winh yet' sk'ab' yok winh, ix b'at yik'ankot sniwanil winh chi' heb'. Ix smukan heb' t'a snanhal Zora yet' Estaol b'aj mukan winh smam winh, haton winhaj Manoa. Ha winhaj Sansón chi', 20 ab'il ix yak' yajalil winh t'a Israel.
